====Banana rum====
{{Checklist|*Travel to [[Musa Point]] with an [[amulet of glory]]
**Pick a banana if you don't have one already
*Run south into the pub and buy a Karamjan rum off Zembo for {{Coins|30}}
*Use the knife on the banana, then use the [[sliced banana]] on your rum.  Unlike normal Karamjan rum, this version is safe to teleport with}}
